svg.title: Darboux frame of the laid yarn at the fell point
svg.desc: Computed oblique view of the reference cylinder around a fell point F: the laid yarn, the free yarn leaving F along its tangent t, the outward surface normal n and b = n × t.
svg.text: Darboux frame (t, n, b = n × t); t′ = κg b − κn n (convex-positive κn)
